Grade: Grade 8
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
Strand: Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping (12 lessons) By the end of the sub strand, the 
Topic 5.2: Income and Budgeting
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 9

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Income and Budgeting, part of Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping (12 lessons) By the end of the sub strand, the  in Grade 8 PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to prepare a personal budget? 2. What are the ethical issues in income and budgeting?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. identify sources of income for an individual,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Income and Budgeting in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. explain the importance of budgeting in day-to-day life,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Income and Budgeting in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. prepare a simple budget for personal financial management,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Income and Budgeting in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

D. explore ethical and unethical practices in budgeting,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Income and Budgeting in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

E. appreciate the importance of financial planning in income management.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Income and Budgeting in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. share experiences on the meaning and sources of income for an individual,
2. brainstorm and present on the importance of budgeting,
3. discuss and present on ways of spending money wisely,
4. prepare a simple personal budget,
5. brainstorm and present on the ethical and unethical practices on income and budgeting. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Income and Budgeting together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and Collaboration: learner acquires writing, speaking, listening and team-working skills when sharing

experiences, brainstorming, and presenting on the sources of income and importance of budgeting.

● Critical Thinking and Problem Solving: learner acquires evaluation skills when preparing a simple personal budget.

Values:
● Integrity: learner develops ethical practices when budgeting and spending money.

● Responsibility: learner performs tasks assigned when brainstorming and presenting on the importance of budgeting.

● Respect: learner appreciates diverse opinions of others when sharing experiences on the meaning and sources of income for

an individual.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

Financial Literacy: learner enhances financial skills when preparing a personal budget and wise spending of money.

Link to other subjects:

Mathematics: learner enhances mathematical operation skills when preparing a simple personal budget.
